functional_definition.statement: Producing a verb-plus-particle combination -- an adverb or preposition particle that changes or refines what the verb means -- as one spoken unit, with the object placed where the combination demands it.
counts_as_realization: the resource's taught production is a verb plus an adverb or preposition particle whose combination means something the bare verb alone does not ("give up" is not every sense of give plus every sense of up; "run out of" is not motion; "figure out" is not seeing) or whose particle refines the verb's sense ("look forward to");

the combination stands as the predicate core of the learner's sentence -- someone stops, discovers, postpones, exhausts or anticipates something -- rather than organising the discourse or managing the social episode;

the learner errors the teaching answers are particle-shaped: a dropped particle, an object pronoun placed on the wrong side of a separable particle, a wrong particle swapped in, or the complement form after the particle chosen wrongly (a bare infinitive where the unit takes a gerund or a that-clause);
the taught realization has the speaker producing the combination inside a proposition with the object or complement in its taught position.
does_not_count: verb--noun partnerships with no meaning-changing particle ("make a decision", "pay attention to", "take part in") -- the word-partnership node's face: their fixedness lives in the noun and its preposition, not in a particle;

whole-clause fixed expressions -- idioms and sentence frames ("the ball is in your court", "Would you mind ...", "The thing is, ...") -- the two shapes of the fixed-expression node: their fixed unit is the clause shape, not a verb's particle;

pragmatic formulas whose taught function is interactional or attitudinal (listener signals, clarification or permission requests, floor bids, hedges, softeners) -- the five pragmatic capability nodes govern those;

prepositional phrases that follow any verb of motion with their ordinary local meaning ("walk into the room", "put the box on the table"): no particle changes the verb, so there is no combination to teach.
boundary_cases: "look forward to" ends in "to", but "forward" is an adverb particle refining the verb and the whole unit is taught as one anticipating unit: it counts here, with the gerund after "to" taught as part of the unit's complement shape.
"carry on" keeps the literal local sense of "on" (continue along) more visibly than "give up" does, but the unit is still a verb-plus-particle combination taught as one predicate: it counts here.
"keep in mind" has a preposition but no adverb particle and nothing about "keep" changes: a word-partnership row, not this node's.

"turn out" in "It turned out that the train was cancelled" takes no object at all: the particle combination works as a whole reporting predicate, which this node counts -- its taught errors are still particle-shaped (a dropped or mis-formed subject arm of the reporting frame).
functional_definition.basis: Authoring judgement made in this repository (queue-2 R1-to-R3 screening, 2026-10), read against the canonical vocabulary that actually exists: docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md §8's PHRASAL_VERB expression subtype and the five pragmatic capability nodes' own does_not_count entries, which place this vocabulary outside their jurisdiction (cap-interact-backchannel names "look forward to" among the proposition vocabulary, cap-ref-ask-clarification names "figure out", "work out" and "turn out" as understanding-reached-by-thinking vocabulary rather than repair moves, cap-eval-hedged-opinion names the act vocabulary). The fourteen canonical families name no lexical family, so family STYLE is the declared nearest reading -- how naturally the predicate is phrased; a canonical family semantics that names a lexical family supersedes this declaration (Revisit registered with DEC-OPI-c91a2957-5f8e-448a-a3a5-9de2f626af36.9). No external psychometric or corpus source is claimed.
